g.text: User uses Director GUI to control actor
data is a json object containing the following attributes:
- `data`: the acquired data on array form
- `axes`: units/labels info for each axis (depends on dimensionnality)
- `label`: a text label for each channel
- `multichannel`: boolean to set if acquisition is multichannel
acquire and send data until something breaks the loop
User asked to break the loop (stop grabbing data!)
